blocks.title: Atomic orbital
blocks.text: Atomic orbital nucleus ke gird khala mein woh seh-jehti (three-dimensional) ilaqa hai jis mein electron ke milne ka imkan (probability) sab se zyada hai.

Har subshell ke orbitals ki apni shaklein hain, jo azimuthal quantum number tai karta hai, aur apne rukh, jo magnetic quantum number tai karta hai. Agle teen topics s, p, d aur f orbitals bari bari bayan karte hain.

blocks.prompt: Wave mechanical model ke mutabiq orbital kya zahir karta hai, aur yeh Bohr ke orbit se kaise mukhtalif hai?
blocks.explanation: Orbital nucleus ke gird khala ka woh ilaqa hai jahan electron ke milne ka sab se zyada imkan hai, jo size, shakal aur rukh ke liye teen quantum numbers se bayan hota hai. Bohr ka orbit muqarrar nisf-qutr ka ek dairawi rasta tha; orbital imkan ka ilaqa hai, rasta nahi.

items: Orbital nucleus ke gird woh ilaqa hai jahan electron milne ka imkan sab se zyada hai; s, p, d aur f orbitals ki apni shaklein aur rukh hain.
